lesson.title: Feelings, Worries & Attitudes
lesson.subtitle: Happiness, sadness, worry, enthusiasm, and willingness
lesson.description: Express feelings, emotions, worries, enthusiasm, effort, and willingness to do things.

learning_objectives: Express positive and negative emotions: 开心, 难过, 生气, 哭, 急, 着急, 害怕, and 怕.
Express attitudes and inner feelings: 感到, 放心, 满意, 热情, 喜爱, 愿意, 努力, and 心里.

metadata.audience: HSK 3.0 Level 3 learners with Level 1-2 foundations

overview.topic_description: Emotional states, attitudes, and expressions of reassurance or concern.
overview.focus: Use 对……满意 for "satisfied with", 对……感兴趣 for "interested in", and 别着急 / 放心 to reassure someone.

grammar_points.title: Using 放心 (fàngxīn)
grammar_points.explanation: 放心 (fàngxīn) means “be reassured; don't worry” (verb).

questions.prompt: How did Xiao Chen’s feelings change by the end of the story?
questions.answer: He felt very happy and was no longer sad or afraid.
questions.explanation: The passage ends with 他感到十分开心，再也不难过了.

questions.prompt: Write two sentences using 放心 and 对……满意 or 愿意.
questions.answer: 请放心，我会努力把工作做好，让大家感到满意。
questions.explanation: Use 放心 and 满意 naturally.
着急 means anxious or worried.
生气 means to get angry.

questions.prompt: Which verb means "to be willing to"?
questions.explanation: 愿意 means to be willing to.

dialogue.title: Cheering Up a Friend
dialogue.context_en: Xiao Lin reassures her friend who is anxious before an exam.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 明天就要考试了，我心里有点儿着急，害怕考不好。
turns.pinyin: Míngtiān jiù yào kǎoshì le, wǒ xīnlǐ yǒudiǎnr zháojí, hàipà kǎo bù hǎo.
turns.english: The exam is tomorrow—I feel anxious inside and am afraid I won’t do well.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 别怕！你这学期一直这么努力，肯定没问题，放心吧。
turns.pinyin: Bié pà! Nǐ zhè xuéqī yìzhí zhème nǔlì, kěndìng méi wèntí, fàngxīn ba.
turns.english: Don’t be afraid! You’ve worked so hard all semester—there’s definitely no problem, rest assured.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 谢谢你这么热情地鼓励我，听你这么说我开心多了！
turns.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ zhème rèqíng de gǔlì wǒ, tīng nǐ zhème shuō wǒ kāixīn duō le!
turns.english: Thank you for encouraging me so warmly—hearing you say that makes me feel much happier!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 如果你愿意，今晚咱们再一起复习半小时，保证让你感到满意！
turns.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yuànyì, jīnwǎn zánmen zài yìqǐ fùxí bàn xiǎoshí, bǎozhèng ràng nǐ gǎndào mǎnyì!
turns.english: If you’re willing, let’s review together for half an hour tonight—I guarantee you’ll feel satisfied!

patterns.title: Being satisfied or interested with 对……满意 / 感兴趣
patterns.explanation_en: Place 对 + target before 满意 (satisfied) or 感兴趣 (interested).
patterns.pattern_hanzi: <Subject> + 对 + <Target> + 很 + 满意 / 感兴趣

examples.hanzi: 客人对这家宾馆的服务非常满意。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén duì zhè jiā bīnguǎn de fúwù fēicháng mǎnyì.
examples.english: The guests are very satisfied with this hotel’s service.

examples.hanzi: 弟弟从小就对历史故事很感兴趣。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi cóngxiǎo jiù duì lìshǐ gùshi hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: My younger brother has been very interested in historical stories since childhood.

patterns.title: Being willing to do something with 愿意
patterns.explanation_en: Place 愿意 (yuànyì) before a verb phrase to say someone is happy or willing to do it.

examples.hanzi: 他非常愿意帮助新来的同学。
examples.pinyin: Tā fēicháng yuànyì bāngzhù xīn lái de tóngxué.
examples.english: He is very willing to help newly arrived classmates.

examples.hanzi: 你愿意周末和我一块儿去看电影吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yuànyì zhōumò hé wǒ yíkuàir qù kàn diànyǐng ma?
examples.english: Are you willing to go see a movie with me this weekend?

reading.title: A Warm Welcome on the First Day

paragraphs.hanzi: 刚转学到新班级那天，小陈心里既紧张又有点儿害怕，担心自己交不到新朋友。
paragraphs.pinyin: Gāng zhuǎnxué dào xīn bānjí nà tiān, Xiǎo Chén xīnlǐ jì jǐnzhāng yòu yǒudiǎnr hàipà, dānxīn zìjǐ jiāo bú dào xīn péngyou.
paragraphs.english: On the day he transferred to a new class, Xiao Chen felt both nervous and a bit afraid inside, worried he wouldn’t make new friends.

paragraphs.hanzi: 没想到班里的同学都非常热情，主动找他聊天儿，还愿意带他熟悉校园。他感到十分开心，再也不难过了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào bān lǐ de tóngxué dōu fēicháng rèqíng, zhǔdòng zhǎo tā liáotiānr, hái yuànyì dài tā shúxī xiàoyuán. Tā gǎndào shífēn kāixīn, zài yě bù nánguò le.
paragraphs.english: Unexpectedly, the classmates were all very warm, took the initiative to chat with him, and were willing to show him around campus. He felt very happy and wasn’t sad anymore.

questions.prompt_en: Why was Xiao Chen afraid on his first day?
questions.answer_en: He was worried he wouldn’t be able to make new friends.

questions.prompt_en: How did his classmates make him feel better?
questions.answer_en: They were warm, chatted with him, and showed him around campus.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Tell a friend not to worry using 放心 and 别着急.

model_answer.hanzi: 别着急，时间还够，你一定能做完，放心吧！
model_answer.pinyin: Bié zháojí, shíjiān hái gòu, nǐ yídìng néng zuò wán, fàngxīn ba!
model_answer.english: Don’t worry—there’s still enough time, you’ll definitely finish, rest assured!

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Say something you are interested in or satisfied with.

model_answer.hanzi: 我对中国音乐很感兴趣，最近学唱了两首新歌，自己挺满意的。
model_answer.pinyin: Wǒ duì Zhōngguó yīnyuè hěn gǎn xìngqù, zuìjìn xué chàng le liǎng shǒu xīn gē, zìjǐ tǐng mǎnyì de.
model_answer.english: I’m very interested in Chinese music; recently I learned two new songs and I’m quite satisfied.

teaching_plan.common_pitfall: 生气 is a separable verb ("get angry"): say 生谁的气 ("get angry at someone") or 对……生气, never *生气他.
teaching_plan.pronunciation_focus: 着急 (zháojí) has two rising second tones; 满意 (mǎnyì) moves from low third tone to falling fourth tone.

can_do: Express happiness, sadness, anger, and worry.
Reassure others with 放心 and 别着急.
Use 对……满意 / 感兴趣 and 愿意.
